app.name: RR VR Import
app.short_description: Import Retro Rewind VR for the WiiVC build
app.long_description: Copies Retro Rewind VR/BR from sd:/RRRating.pul (or sd:/RetroRewind6/RRRating.pul) into /shared2/Pulsar/RetroRewind6/RRRating.pul, which the WiiVC build reads. Entries with the same profile ID are replaced; other entries are kept. The old copy is backed up to sd:/RRRating-vwii-backup.pul. Nothing is written until you press A.
